Mammografia: microcalcificazioni fini pl: Mammography: fine pleomorphic and linear-branching segmental microcalcifications in an area of asymmetry of about 3 cm in the left upper outer quadrant; carcinoma (Luminal B)
Donna di 37 anni. Mammografia bilaterale: 37-year-old woman. Bilateral mammography in two views (CC and MLO). Clinical question not available.
Referta in ordine: composizione, reperti: Report in order: composition, findings, conclusion with BI-RADS category.
Le calcificazioni fini lineari o lineari:
Fine linear or linear-branching (“script-like”) calcifications and fine pleomorphic ones are the most suspicious morphologies in the BI-RADS lexicon; segmental distribution (triangular with the apex toward the nipple, along a duct) raises suspicion further, because it suggests a carcinoma growing within the ducts (intraductal component).
Here the calcifications occupy an area of about 3 cm in the upper outer quadrant and lie within an asymmetric density with indistinct margins, visible in two views: the whole is BI-RADS 5 (at least 4C).
Management: stereotactic vacuum-assisted biopsy of the calcifications (with specimen radiography), targeted ultrasound of the area and the axilla to look for a solid component or a lymph node to biopsy, MRI for extent: the area of calcifications often underestimates the extent of the tumor.
In dense breasts the calcifications remain visible, whereas masses hide: view the calcifications with Zoom or the Magnifier.
Outcome from the collection: left breast carcinoma, Luminal B subtype.
Calcificazioni lineari ramificate o segm: Linear-branching or segmental calcifications: BI-RADS 5 and biopsy; the true extent of the tumor is often greater.
Carcinoma mammario sinistro confermato d: Left breast carcinoma confirmed by biopsy, Luminal B molecular subtype (CMMD clinical data).
